Title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue with the death icon at certain resolutions. Begone pesky pixel!
  • Spell Power no longer increases the Health restored by activating Hearthstone.
  • Fixed an issue with allied Pings on the Party Frame.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed a typo in the name for Xal'atath's Loot Chest.

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper attacks to instantly hit nearby targets.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper warning areas to persist indefinitely.

=== Battlegrounds: Towers of Doom ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper attacks to instantly hit nearby targets.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Sapper warning areas to persist indefinitely.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Locust's self-healing no longer contribute to Abathur's Self Healing score.
  • [Undocumented] Volatile Mutation's healing no longer contribute to Abathur's Self Healing score if the source of damage is not a Hero.

=== Heroes: Artanis ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Blade Dash aiming guide updated from Fantasy preset to Sci-Fi preset.
  • [Undocumented] Phase Prism aiming guide updated from Fantasy preset to Sci-Fi preset.

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 16
    • Wrath of Heaven

=== Heroes: Blaze ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 13
    • Adhesive Petroleum
      • Fixed an issue that caused Adhesive Petroleum to grant its Basic Attack damage bonus to other Blaze players who do not have the Talent selected.

=== Heroes: Cho ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Surging Fist to reduce Cho's terrain collision radius after being used.

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Once Again the First Time
      • [Undocumented] Echo mimic Basic Attacks damage increased from 50% to 55%.
      • [Undocumented] Echo mimic Sand Blast damage unchanged, equal to 50%.
    • Deep Breathing
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 0.5% to 0.6%.
    • Timewalker's Pursuit
      • Damage bonus reduced from 15% to 12%.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • Basic Attack damage increased from 100 to 105.
  • Health increased from 2275 to 2375.
  • [Undocumented] Health Regeneration increased from 4.74 to 4.94.
  Base:
  • Deth Lazor [W]
    • Life Leech increased from 25% to 30%.
  Talents:
  • Level 20
    • Bomb Toss
      • No longer grants an additional charge.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 1
    • Pathfinder
      • Fixed an issue that caused Genji to [Undocumented] ~~no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after~~ not lose Unrevealable when Pathfinder expires.

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Incendiary Elixir
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 25 to 30.
  • Level 20
    • Gilnean Roulette
      • No longer reduces the percentage based Health damage.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 4
    • Eyes in the Dark
      • Fixed an issue that caused Greymane to [Undocumented] ~~no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after~~ to not lose Unrevealable when Eyes in the Dark expires.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Water Elemental Wintermute Frostbolt aiming guide updated from Generic preset to Fantasy preset.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Cloud Serpent [W]
      • Fixed an issue that allowed Cloud Serpent casts on allied Heroes to become disjointed [Undocumented] if the target teleported between cast and application .

=== Heroes: Lunara ===
[User Interface]
  • [Undocumented] Thornwood Vine aiming guide updated from Generic preset to Fantasy preset.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the far right aiming guide for For The Wildlands to not have the correct height.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Party Mix
      • Quest completion radius bonus increased from 20% to 30%.
  • Level 10
    • Sound Barrier
      • Shield amount per stack increased from 27 to 31.
      • [Undocumented] Shield increased from 1296 to 1488.
  • Level 13
    • Slip
      • Lingering duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
  • Level 20
    • Summer Anthem
      • Unkillable duration increased from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.

=== Heroes: Medivh ===
[User Interface]
  • Added a radius indicator to Force of Will's cast guide after selecting Circle of Protection.
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Arcane Rift [Q]
    • Damage increased from 170 to 185.
  • Force of Will [W]
    • Cooldown reduced from 9 to 8 seconds.
  • Portal [E]
    • Cooldown increased from 16 to 20 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Winds of Celerity
      • Now also reduces cast time by 0.25 seconds.
    • Raven's Intellect
      • Bonus increased from 200% to 400%.
    • Portal Mastery
      • No longer allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.
  • Level 4
    • Dust of Appearance
      • Cooldown reduced from 45 to 40 seconds.
      • Now allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.
      • [Undocumented] No longer grants increased vision in Raven Form.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 20
    • Dust of Disappearance
      • Fixed an issue that caused targeted allies to not automatically acquire nearby targets after Stealth expires.

=== Heroes: Mei ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Blizzard [W]
    • Detonation delay reduced from 2 to 1.875 seconds.
    • Detonation damage increased from 75 to 80.
  • Icing [E]
    • Cast time [Undocumented] ~~reduced~~ increased from [Undocumented] ~~0.625~~ 0.125 to 0.5 seconds.
    • [Undocumented] Dash duration reduced from 0.9375 to 0.875 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 10
    • Avalanche
      • Cooldown reduced from 90 to 80 seconds.
    • Ice Wall
      • [Undocumented] ~~Cast time~~ Delay reduced from 0.75 to 0.6875 seconds.

=== Heroes: Mephisto ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Malicious Intent
      • Spell Power bonus increased from 25% to 30%.
      • Duration increased from 2.5 to 3 seconds.
  • Level 4
    • Hateful Mending
      • Mana restored increased from 10 to 15.
      • Healing increased from 70% to 85%.
    • Static Barrier
      • Shield amount increased from 40% to 50%.

=== Heroes: Stukov ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Fetid Touch
      • Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.
  • Level 10
    • Flailing Swipe
      • Damage increased from 48 to 62.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 13
    • Shadow Walk
      • Fixed an issue that caused Tassadar to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Shadow Walk expires.

=== Heroes: Xal'atath ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Shadow Mark [Q]
    • Range increased from 8 to 9.
  • Dark Heart Ritual [W]
    • Detonation damage increased from 245 to 260.
  • Void Volley [D]
    • Mythic Reward damage bonus reduced from 50% to 35%.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Anchored Core
      • No longer increases Dark Heart Ritual's duration.
    • Cloak of Shadows
      • Now grants Spell Armor only during Void Step, and not also for 2 seconds after it ends.
  • Level 4
    • Cold Feet
      • Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
  • Level 7
    • Toxic Mark
      • No longer increases debuff duration.
      • Now benefits from Cold Feet's duration bonus.
  • Level 10
    • Void Eruption
      • Damage per second reduced by 10%.
      • Speed reduced by 10%.
  • Level 16
    • Marked Resilience
      • Shield amount increased from 160 to 200.
    • Relentless Whispers
      • No longer increases Attack Speed.
      • Now grants an additional 75% Basic Attack damage per teleport.
    • Fractured Reality
      • Damage bonus reduced from 25% to 15%.
  • Level 20
    • Harbinger's Consumption
      • Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 14 to 10 seconds.
      • The three orbs now orbit more slowly.
    • Unstable Core
      • No longer applies a damage over time to targets.
      • Impact damage increased from 45 to 75.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Shadow Mark [Q]
      • Fixed issues that caused Structures to be marked by Shadow Mark in unintended situations.
    • Dark Heart Ritual [W]
      • Fixed issues related to Dark Heart Ritual's self-reveal logic [Undocumented] when hitting enemies from fog of war .
      • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Dark Heart Ritual to break Unrevealable when first created for 1.1 seconds.
    • Void Volley [D]
      • Fixed an issue that caused Void Volley to gain progress when attacking a target with 1 Evasion charge remaining.
  • Level 4
    • Void Acolyte
      • Fixed an issue that caused Void Acolyte to not empower Void Volley.
  • Level 7
    • Void Summoner
      • Fixed an issue that caused Void Summoner to not spawn the Void Minion at Xal'atath's position at cast time [Undocumented] but at Xal'atath's new position after the first teleport .

=== Heroes: Xul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Bone Prison [E]
      • Xul will no longer be revealed to the enemy if he is in the fog of war when Bone Prison activates.
